rename_policy: A renamed module inherits a fingerprint if and only if the error code and the line-agnostic message both match. Line numbers are excluded from the fingerprint so that unrelated edits above an error do not invalidate it; module path, code, and message together are specific enough that a genuinely new error cannot be absorbed by an old entry.
